segments.en: Hello.
Hello.
Can you hear me?
Yes, where are you speaking from?
I am from Salem, where are you speaking from?
I am from Salem, what are you doing?
I am working in Salem, what about you?
I am also working.
What work do you do?
I am a supervisor in a company, what about you?
Okay, okay.
How is work going?
Work is going great, how long have you been using this app?
I just started using it today.
You just started today? Why did you start, and who told you to start?
No one told me to start, I saw an ad for the app.
I see.
I wanted to see how it is.
If you want to use it like that, you don't need to, you can just watch reels on Instagram and go.
There are a lot of bad boys here.
They will ask for video calls, ask for numbers, 90% of them are like that.
There are also good people here.
What?
I mean, there are good people too, like you.
That is okay.
Some people come here knowing everything, I can handle them, I am single anyway.
People who are clear have no problem.
For those who are new and don't know, some people talk nicely and get their numbers, then call at 10 PM for video calls, and it causes a lot of trouble at home.
Oh my god.
Someone was telling me that.
Okay, it is okay that you are advising me, thanks a lot.
I don't know about others, but...
Actually, I tell everyone who is new that it will be like this.
Sometimes, when I go on long drives, I might be talking to someone on the phone.
If I think I am talking to someone, I won't feel sleepy, even if I listen to songs, I will fall asleep.
Talking doesn't really matter, so I just let it be.
Okay, okay.
I see a lot of people here.
It is not just men, there are many women working here too.
Oh my god.
Give me money, I will give you my WhatsApp number, we can talk on WhatsApp.
If we talk for an hour, it will only cost 100 rupees, give me 200 rupees and we can talk more, and they use all sorts of tricks to lure us.
They just take us for a ride.
That is true.
If you talk like this, it will be fine.
